summary_for_children: Fatir means The Originator. It praises Allah who created the heavens and the earth and shows signs in colours: fruits, mountains, people and animals of every colour, and fresh and salty seas.
environment_concept: Mountains streaked white, red and black (35:27), orchards in many colours (35:27) and two seas, fresh and salt, with pearls (35:12).
architecture_and_scenery: Striped mountains, orchards, pearl beaches, and a sky streaked with wings of light suggested only by colour, never angels.

palette.lighting: Bright clear daylight to show colour

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

unique_world.visual_theme: A valley with a banded white, red and black cliff, an orchard, a shearing pen and an atlas of three benches between them

primary_mechanic.text: Gather stones from the banded cliff, fruits from the orchard and wool from the pen, and lay each row of the atlas from the lightest at the left end to the darkest at the right (35:27-28). A full row out of order sends the misplaced things back; a row in order is read.

secondary_activities: mercy no one can hold back (35:2)
unique_world.narrative_structure: The sign, then the three rows in any order, then the closing reading (35:19-21)
world_assets: atlas benches with light and dark end posts
environment_behaviour: things sit where they are found until carried
placed things show on the bench; a finished row glows
unique_world.learning_objective: Look closely at the colours the verses name (35:27-28) and learn that knowledge brings awe of Allah

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: The World of Colors
story_library.children_narration: Have you noticed that mountains can have different colors, fruits can grow in many shades, and animals have beautiful patterns? Surah Fatir reminds us to look closely at the diversity of Allah's creation. The more we learn about the world, the more reasons we may find to be grateful and humble.

world_idea.title: The Living Color Atlas
world_idea.description: Explore mineral formations, colorful mountains, orchards, and animal habitats through a nature-observation adventure.

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
